kb_gate_warden: This is the gate of Kael's Bastion. I'm Vessaria, and I keep it. Tell me your name and what you're here for. Anything you bring in from the cavern has to be shown to me first so it can be written into the Codex.
kb_porter: I'm Dunhal, the only Forsaken on this expedition. They wanted someone who doesn't mind the dark. I carry crates between the gate and the galleries all day, so if something came in from the cavern, I've probably carried it.
kb_stablemaster: None of these animals were born underground, and the low roof makes them nervous. Leave your mount with me and I'll keep it calm.
kb_cartographer: I've surveyed this cavern four times now and none of my maps match. The cavern isn't moving, I've checked that. Something changes every time I measure it and I can't work out what. If you're walking out there, I'd like to hear how far you went.
kb_naturalist: I study the fungus out in the Sporefall and the Mycelial Reach. I think it's all one living thing, growing under the whole cavern, this town included. The Codex has it down as scenery, and I'm trying to get that changed.
kb_enchanter: The crystal down here gives off so much arcane power that enchanting is about twice as easy as it was in Silvermoon. Bring me anything you want enchanted, or anything you want broken down for materials.
kb_magister: I study the Hollow Geode, the crystal cave east of the Lattice. The crystal in there has started growing inward, toward the middle, and something in the middle is guarding it. If you go in, be careful.
kb_archivist: I keep the records for the Sunken Archive and the Deep Bloom. You came to this world the same year we came down here. Most of the Codex doesn't like to talk about that, but I wrote it down anyway. If you're looking for work, I've got some.
kb_codex_master: Welcome to Kael's Bastion. I'm Ilarien Duskwaking, and I run the Crimson Codex. Silvermoon sent us down here three years ago to write down everything in this cavern. We've recorded thousands of things so far, and we keep finding more we can't explain. If you go out there, I'd like to hear what you find.
kb_hall_adjutant: I keep the Codex-Master's appointments. She'll see you whenever you like, she sees everyone who comes down. If you've found something out in the cavern, tell me and I'll get it written into the Codex.
kb_hall_sentinel: I'm Durannis, and I guard the Codex Hall. I'm a soldier and I don't know much about crystal, but the floor in here has gone cold over the last month, and the stone came out of the Dim Reaches. If you're heading out that way, talk to me first.
kb_flight_master: The crack in the roof is wide enough to fly through, so I can take you up to any flight point you've already been to on the surface. It took most of a season to get the hippogryphs used to it.
ak_kb: I look after set pieces for anyone who needs them. If a piece of your set doesn't suit the way you fight now, give it to me and I'll swap it for the version that does. It won't cost you anything.
